title: Application Launcher's Screen Locker's Context Menu appears for 1 frame after unlocking the session
line: After locking the screen from the Application Launcher's Session menu, the menu no longer flashes on screen when you unlock.
explanation: Choosing Lock closes the Session menu, and KWin's Fading Popups effect starts fading it out. The lock screen then takes over within that fade, and while locked KWin doesn't paint the windows underneath, so the fade's timeline stops advancing and the closed menu is kept alive. After unlocking, the menu is painted again and finishes its fade (one frame with animations disabled, about half a second at normal speed). The change makes Fading Popups cancel its animations when the screen is locked or unlocked, as Sliding Popups already does for the Kickoff popup itself.

commits.message:
plugins/fadingpopups: Cancel animations when screen is locked/unlocked

Windows below the lock screen aren't painted, so a popup that was still
fading out when the screen got locked stayed frozen and finished fading
only after unlocking. Cancel the animations like slidingpopups does.

BUG: 518425

media.caption: Animations instant, 60 fps (sweep tester): the first desktop frame after unlocking shows the Session menu floating above the panel.
Animations instant, with the fix: lock screen, then the desktop with no menu in any frame.
Normal animation speed: lock screen, then the Session menu reappears after unlocking and fades out over about half a second.
Normal animation speed, with the fix: the same frames after unlocking show no menu.
